description: AM35 DPI color per-stage read (FunctionArea.get_dpi_lights in disassembly/AM35model.dis line 1923). For each stage id 1-8, sends '05 5A 06 00 0C 0A 2<id> 62 E8 03' where the byte at offset 6 is 0x21+id-1 (string concatenation of '2' + str(id), interpreted as hex). Response RGB is at parser offset 17-19 (Python res[18:21] before report-id strip). Source: disassembly/AM35model.dis get_dpi_lights (line 1923), hex_str[36:42] = bytes 18-20.

samples.comment: Stage 1: stage_byte=0x21=33, RGB red at offset 17
